description:
RadioUpnp lets you enjoy web radios with uninterrupted playback.
Now with Google Cast support! Stream your favorite radios directly to Cast-enabled devices, UPnP, or DLNA speakers — perfect for smart homes or audiophile setups.
Minimalist and fully customizable, you can easily build your own playlist:
• Search and add radios directly in the app.
• Share results from RadioGarden straight to RadioUpnp.
• Still missing a station? Add it manually.
Two UPnP streaming modes are available: Passthrough (the original stream is relayed directly to the device) or PCM (the stream is transcoded to a standard PCM format for maximum compatibility).
Completely free and ad-free. Support development via the Donate menu. Thank you!
📌 Troubleshooting Tips:
• Some phone brands (e.g. Samsung, OnePlus) may apply battery optimization that disrupts streaming. Disable optimization in battery settings for RadioUpnp.
• Streaming quality and compatibility depend on your UPnP/DLNA device (supported CODECs, etc.).
• If you use ad blockers or firewall apps, UPnP streaming may be blocked.
• Need help? Use the in-app Report function to contact the developer.
